usage: for flat, sheet-like objects: paper, tables, beds, photos and tickets.
exampleEn: I want to buy a table.

usage: for things with handles (umbrellas, knives, keys, chairs); also a handful (一把花生) and lending a hand (帮一把).
example: 外面下雨了，带一把伞吧。
exampleEn: It is raining outside — take an umbrella.

usage: for layers, floors of a building (一层楼) and coatings (一层奶油).
exampleEn: This shop has three floors.

usage: for sentences and lines of speech (一句话, 两句中文).
exampleEn: He did not say a single word.

usage: for periods of time (一段时间), stretches of road (一段路) and passages of text or speech (一段话).
example: 我学了一段时间的中文。
exampleEn: I have been studying Chinese for a while.

usage: for letters and mail (一封信, 一封邮件).
example: 我昨天给妈妈写了一封信。
exampleEn: I wrote a letter to Mom yesterday.

usage: page (第三页 = the third page; 一页纸).
exampleEn: Please turn to page three.

usage: for classes (一节课), railway cars (一节车厢) and batteries (一节电池).
example: 今天上午有两节中文课。
exampleEn: I have two Chinese classes this morning.

usage: for farm animals such as cows and pigs (一头牛), and for garlic bulbs (一头蒜).
exampleEn: Grandpa keeps three cows.

usage: a sound, call or cry (喊了一声, 一声谢谢).
exampleEn: He gave a loud shout.

usage: for wheeled vehicles: cars, buses and bicycles.
exampleEn: My family has two cars.

usage: for pairs of things that come in twos (a pair of shoes, socks, chopsticks).
exampleEn: I bought a new pair of shoes.

usage: jin, a Chinese weight unit equal to 500 grams (half a kilogram); 半斤 = half a jin.
exampleEn: I bought two jin of apples.

usage: kilogram (一公斤 = 1000 grams).
exampleEn: This watermelon weighs two kilograms.

usage: meter, the unit of length (三米长 = three meters long).
exampleEn: This bed is two meters long.

usage: mao, the everyday unit of money equal to one-tenth of a yuan (五毛钱, 一块五毛).
exampleEn: This milk tea costs three yuan and fifty fen.

usage: jiao, the formal unit equal to one-tenth of a yuan — the same value as 毛 (一角钱).
exampleEn: A stamp costs eight jiao.

usage: kind, type or sort (一种水果, 这种书); with 这/那 it can be used alone: 这种.
exampleEn: I like this kind of apple the most.

usage: a traditional unit for a quarter of an hour (一刻钟 = 15 minutes); 九点一刻 = quarter past nine.
exampleEn: It is a quarter past nine now.

usage: time, occasion — a casual word for 次 (去过一回); also 下一回 = next time.
exampleEn: Let's go hiking next time.

usage: once through from beginning to end (看一遍, 读三遍) — unlike 次, it stresses covering the whole thing.
exampleEn: I have watched this movie twice.

usage: a bowl of (一碗米饭, 一碗面).
exampleEn: He ate a bowl of noodles.

usage: a bottle of (一瓶水, 一瓶牛奶).
exampleEn: There is a bottle of milk in the fridge.

usage: a box or case of (一箱牛奶, 一箱书).
exampleEn: A box of books is sitting in the room.

usage: a spoonful of (一勺糖, 两勺盐).
exampleEn: Please add a spoonful of sugar for me.

usage: a boat-load of (一船鱼, 一船货物).
exampleEn: This boatload of fish is very fresh.

usage: a room full of (一屋子人, 一屋子东西).
exampleEn: The living room is packed full of people.

usage: a face covered or filled with (一脸汗, 一脸灰, 一脸笑容).
exampleEn: He ran so much that his face is covered in sweat.
